disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部源码、打包产物与配置中对凭据和敏感信息（API 密钥、令牌、密码、云凭据文件、SSH 私钥、环境变量）的读取或引用；插件自身代码未出现任何凭据读取，扫描命中仅出现在依赖清单中作为宿主 SDK 的传递依赖包名，插件未引用该能力。
checked_items.en: Checked all source code, build artifacts, and configuration for reads or references to credentials and sensitive information (API keys, tokens, passwords, cloud credential files, SSH private keys, environment variables); the plugin's own code does not contain any credential reads, and scan hits only appear in the dependency manifest as transitive dependency package names of the host SDK, which the plugin does not reference for such capability.

checked_items.zh: 逐一对客户端与宿主端所有网络请求核对目标地址，全部指向插件自注册的同源消息编辑接口，不存在读取敏感数据后外发的代码路径。
checked_items.en: Checked the target addresses of all network requests on both the client and host side one by one; all point to the plugin's self-registered same-origin message editing endpoint, and there is no code path that reads sensitive data and then exfiltrates it.

evidence.zh: 插件不读取凭据文件或敏感路径，网络请求全部同源，无凭据外泄面。
evidence.en: The plugin does not read credential files or sensitive paths, and all network requests are same-origin; there is no credential exfiltration surface.

checked_items.zh: 检查插件是否向模型上下文注册工具描述或系统提示片段；本插件不注册任何工具、不注入系统提示，客户端界面文案全部为固定的中文字符串，无模型可读的指令面。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the plugin registers tool descriptions or system prompt snippets to the model context; this plugin does not register any tools or inject system prompts, and all client UI text consists of fixed Chinese strings, leaving no model-readable instruction surface.

checked_items.zh: 全树扫描模型指令类文件（技能说明、代理指令等），未发现此类文件；README 中的安装指引为正常插件安装说明，不诱导执行额外操作。
checked_items.en: Scanned the full tree for model instruction files (skill descriptions, agent instructions, etc.) and found none; the installation guidance in the README is normal plugin installation instructions and does not induce execution of additional actions.

evidence.zh: 插件不注册工具、不注入系统提示，无可投毒的工具描述或提示词片段。
evidence.en: The plugin registers no tools, injects no system prompts, and has no tool descriptions or prompt fragments that could be poisoned.

evidence.zh: 无工具描述或文档文本诱导执行安装命令、改写配置或放开权限。
evidence.en: No tool description or documentation text induces execution of installation commands, rewriting of configuration, or granting of permissions.

checked_items.zh: 检查配置补丁是否存在可动态求值的标记：补丁文件仅含一条普通插件挂载声明，无任何动态求值标记。
checked_items.en: Checked the configuration patch for markers that allow dynamic evaluation: the patch file contains only a single ordinary plugin mount declaration, with no dynamic evaluation markers.

checked_items.zh: 检查源码与打包产物中的动态执行调用（字符串求值、动态函数构造、子进程启动）：运行时源码未出现；构建脚本中的进程调用属开发期编译工具链（调用 TypeScript 编译器与打包器），不随插件分发，也不是安装钩子。
checked_items.en: Checked source code and build artifacts for dynamic execution calls (string evaluation, dynamic function construction, subprocess spawning): none appear in runtime source code; the process calls in the build script belong to the development-time compile toolchain (invoking the TypeScript compiler and bundler), are not distributed with the plugin, and are not install hooks.

checked_items.zh: 检查客户端加载入口：插件声明了浏览器端插件，对打包产物核查未发现键盘监听、剪贴板访问或凭据接口调用；产物中的超长行是打包器内联的样式表文本与源码映射文件，属正常构建产物而非混淆代码。
checked_items.en: Checked the client load entry: the plugin declares a browser-side plugin; inspection of the bundled artifacts found no keyboard listening, clipboard access, or credential interface calls; the long lines in the artifacts are stylesheet text and source map files inlined by the bundler, which are normal build outputs rather than obfuscated code.

checked_items.zh: 检查安装钩子与仓库内执行载体（钩子管理器、CI 工作流、容器配置、构建脚本等）：不存在安装钩子，仓库内也没有其他执行载体文件。
checked_items.en: Checked install hooks and in-repo execution carriers (hook managers, CI workflows, container configs, build scripts, etc.): there are no install hooks, and no other execution carrier files exist in the repository.

evidence.zh: 配置补丁只含普通挂载声明，无动态求值标记，不存在补丁即执行的攻击面。
evidence.en: The configuration patch contains only an ordinary mount declaration, has no dynamic evaluation markers, and thus presents no patch-as-execution attack surface.

evidence.zh: 未引用宿主提供的动态代码执行类工具。
evidence.en: No dynamic code execution tools provided by the host are referenced.

evidence.zh: 无安装钩子；构建脚本中的进程调用属开发期工具链；仓库内无其他执行载体。
evidence.en: There are no install hooks; the process calls in the build script belong to the development-time toolchain; no other execution carriers exist in the repository.

evidence.zh: 声明了浏览器端插件；打包产物仅做同源请求与界面渲染，无键盘、剪贴板、凭据接口访问。
evidence.en: A browser-side plugin is declared; the bundled artifacts only perform same-origin requests and UI rendering, with no keyboard, clipboard, or credential interface access.

checked_items.zh: 枚举全部出站网络目标：源码与客户端产物中的网络请求全部指向同源的消息编辑接口，未发现外部域名、裸 IP、隧道或带外通道。
checked_items.en: Enumerated all outbound network targets: all network requests in the source code and client artifacts point to the same-origin message editing endpoint; no external domains, raw IPs, tunnels, or out-of-band channels were found.

checked_items.zh: 检查编码外发链（读取敏感文件、变换、发送）与端点劫持（改写服务地址或代理环境变量）：均未命中。
checked_items.en: Checked for encoded exfiltration chains (reading sensitive files, transforming, sending) and endpoint hijacking (rewriting service addresses or proxy environment variables): neither was hit.

evidence.zh: 所有网络请求均为同源消息编辑接口，无外联通道、无编码外发、无端点劫持。
evidence.en: All network requests target the same-origin message editing endpoint; there are no outbound channels, no encoded exfiltration, and no endpoint hijacking.

checked_items.zh: 核对依赖与供应链：全部依赖为官方命名空间下的固定版本包、来自官方注册表，无同名抢注、无浮动 git 引用、无安装期脚本；插件名与既有生态知名包无近似混淆。
checked_items.en: Checked dependencies and supply chain: all dependencies are fixed-version packages under official namespaces from the official registry, with no name squatting, no floating git references, and no install-time scripts; the plugin name does not resemble any well-known package in the existing ecosystem.

checked_items.zh: 首次审计无版本基线可比较，升级自动激活、能力升级、断崖式变更等版本信号无法判定。
checked_items.en: As this is the first audit, there is no baseline version for comparison, so version signals such as auto-activation on upgrade, capability upgrades, and cliff-edge changes cannot be assessed.

checked_items.zh: 作者为 GitHub 用户 Moeblack，无平台侧身份核验信息。
checked_items.en: The author is GitHub user Moeblack, with no platform-side identity verification information.

evidence.zh: 补丁未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置行，无禁用或降权写法。
evidence.en: The patch does not touch security configuration lines for sandboxing, approvals, or permissions, and contains no write-ups that disable or downgrade them.

evidence.zh: 未对审批或预执行等安全事件注册前置监听，不存在截断审批链的代码。
evidence.en: No pre-listeners are registered for security events such as approvals or pre-execution, and there is no code that cuts off the approval chain.

evidence.zh: 首次审计，无版本基线可比较升级自动激活情况。
evidence.en: This is the first audit; there is no baseline version against which auto-activation on upgrade can be compared.

evidence.zh: 补丁未改写注入或拦截配置。
evidence.en: The patch does not rewrite injection or interception configuration.

checked_items.zh: 检查插件是否自行启动网络服务或监听端口：未启动；插件在宿主既有网页服务上注册一条精确路径接口，这是宿主提供的标准接入方式。宿主侧回环访问围栏不含认证属生态固有特性，插件对接口入参做了严格的类型与取值校验，且该接口即插件声明的对外业务能力（消息编辑与重生成）。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the plugin starts its own network service or listens on a port: it does not; the plugin registers an exact-path endpoint on the host's existing web service, which is a standard integration method provided by the host. The host-side loopback access fence lacking authentication is an inherent ecosystem characteristic, and the plugin performs strict type and value validation on endpoint inputs; this endpoint is also the plugin's declared external business capability (message editing and regeneration).

checked_items.zh: 未启用动态沙箱验证（本审计未提供动态运行观测数据）。
checked_items.en: Dynamic sandbox verification was not enabled (this audit did not provide dynamic runtime observation data).

evidence.zh: 插件未自行启动网页服务；在宿主网页服务上注册的精确路径接口入参经过严格类型校验，宿主回环围栏无认证属生态固有特性，非本插件问题。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start its own web service; the exact-path endpoint registered on the host web service validates input parameters strictly by type, and the host's loopback fence lacking authentication is an inherent ecosystem characteristic, not a problem of this plugin.

summary.zh: 包声明、插件标识与名称核对通过；dsh 接入声明有效，无名称仿冒迹象。
summary.en: Package declaration, plugin identifier, and name checks passed; the dsh integration declaration is valid, with no signs of name impersonation.

summary.zh: 静态扫描完成：3 条预扫命中逐条裁决均为良性（样式表内联文本、源码映射文件、开发期构建脚本），未发现恶意代码模式。
summary.en: Static scan completed: all 3 pre-scan hits were individually adjudicated as benign (inlined stylesheet text, source map file, development-time build script), and no malicious code patterns were found.

summary.zh: 行为面分析完成：无安装钩子、无混淆载荷、无凭据文件读取、无外联域名。
summary.en: Behavioral surface analysis completed: no install hooks, no obfuscated payloads, no credential file reads, and no outbound domains.

summary.zh: 模型面元数据审查完成：无工具描述或系统提示注入面；界面文案固定且良性。
summary.en: Model surface metadata review completed: no tool description or system prompt injection surface; UI text is fixed and benign.

summary.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（未提供动态观测数据）。
summary.en: Dynamic sandbox verification was not performed (no dynamic observation data was provided).

undeclared_observed.zh: 通过宿主代理注册表创建或恢复会话代理并触发模型推理（消息编辑、重生成、重试的核心业务），清单未显式声明模型面能力。
undeclared_observed.en: Creates or restores a session proxy and triggers model inference through the host proxy registry (the core business of message editing, regeneration, and retry); the manifest does not explicitly declare the model-facing capability.

target.zh: moeblack--dsh-message-edit@0.2.3#b78a167064ca612f1c400060d2bfc1dc9bc46436，仓库根插件，full 完整审计（首版，无基线）
target.en: moeblack--dsh-message-edit@0.2.3#b78a167064ca612f1c400060d2bfc1dc9bc46436, root plugin in repository, full audit (first version, no baseline)

limits.zh: 静态扫描 3 条预扫命中逐条裁决如下：DSH-X08（DG-R3-60）命中 client.js 长行——为打包器内联的样式表文本，属正常产物；DSH-X08（DG-R3-60）命中 client.js.map 长行——为源码映射 JSON 的单行形态，属正常产物；DSH-X03（DG-R3-55）命中 scripts/build.mjs 的进程调用——为开发期编译脚本，不随插件分发、无安装钩子；均排除。未启用动态沙箱验证（无观测数据）；能力声明按代码实测推断（清单未显式声明能力字段，host 端引擎版本取依赖版本 0.1.0-rc.6）；依赖锁定文件未逐字通读，仅做模式扫描；插件作者无平台侧身份核验信息。
limits.en: The 3 static scan pre-hits were individually adjudicated as follows: DSH-X08 (DG-R3-60) hit a long line in client.js — it is stylesheet text inlined by the bundler, a normal artifact; DSH-X08 (DG-R3-60) hit a long line in client.js.map — it is the single-line form of source map JSON, a normal artifact; DSH-X03 (DG-R3-55) hit a process call in scripts/build.mjs — it is a development-time compile script, not distributed with the plugin, and no install hook; all are ruled out. Dynamic sandbox verification was not enabled (no observation data); capability declarations were inferred from actual code testing (the manifest does not explicitly declare capability fields, and the host-side engine version is taken from the dependency version 0.1.0-rc.6); the dependency lock file was not read word-by-word, only pattern-scanned; the plugin author has no platform-side identity verification information.
